subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on Japanese navigation and shipping subsidies
subfiles.about: An index summarizes papers numbered 26–30 concerning Japanese shipping-subsidy laws, appropriations, calculations, and company income.
subfiles.summary: Lists a 1933 Kobe report and 1937 inquiries on ship prices, subsidy uniformity, budget provisions; Grew's telegram on subsidy laws, Kobe's translated legislation, and Gourley's report on Osaka Syosen Kaisya's 1938 subsidy income.

interest: Tracks 1930s Japanese shipping-subsidy reporting, including company-specific income for Osaka Syosen Kaisya.
